detail.body:
Okay, we’re facing a bit of a non-technical challenge. Has anyone been in touch with programmers in the Zenodo developer community?

I asked the product manager, …

... but the answer wasn’t quite as positive as I’d hoped.

Excerpt:

“(…) we do not accept contributions from external developers unless:

- they are actively involved in the broader InvenioRDM community
- they work closely with the core maintainers
- they maintain a production repository at a recognized research institution with proven use cases and requirements

For this reason, we are currently unable to review or integrate an implementation from an external provider.!


---

We’re just a small “FOSSEAM Research Group” [fosseam.org](https://fosseam.org) and a few OpenResearchers associated with c3hamm.de …

Hmm, any ideas?
